# dsh-plugin-git
English | 中文
## Summary
Standard DSH/Cordis Git plugin with one portable Host service, one Client bundle, and optional Deskt
op enhancement. The package runs unchanged in DeepSeek Harness Desktop and in a standard DSH Web hos
t; the npm scope `@dsh-electron/` identifies the publisher, not a runtime requirement.
**Requires the upstream right sidebar.** Supported DSH releases are listed in the compatibility cont
ract; their Client UI ships the right sidebar (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right`). Git regi
sters three sidebar tab types through the standard two-stage path and navigates through `ctx.sidebar
Right`; without the right sidebar the Client half cannot load. The third-party Details Host plugin i
s deprecated and no longer depended on. See the DSH compatibility contract for the verified release
recated and no longer depended on. See the DSH compatibility contract for the verified release list.
DeepSeek Harness Desktop pre-installs this plugin and mirrors this repository with git subtree. User
s may disable Git from the Plugins settings; the right sidebar is an upstream built-in.
## DSH compatibility
See the compatibility contract for the exact verified releases, development pin, host Node requireme
nts, and candidate upgrade process.
## Installation
The package is published to npm as `@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-git` (current `0.2.9`, MIT, with build
provenance). It is still experimental development: the API and versioning remain pre-1.0 and may cha
nge between minor releases.
**DeepSeek Harness Desktop** — Git is pre-installed and enabled by default. Disable it from **Settin
gs → Plugins** when you do not need repository UI.
**DSH Web** — every supported release ships the right sidebar, so Git alone is enough. The shortest
path is two commands:

/ git | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:cherrchen/dsh-plugin-git` | Fetches sources and builds
them on install through `prepare`; needs `allowBuilds`, pin a tag |
Whichever source you use, the Git client requires the host to already provide the `ctx.sidebarRight`
and `ctx.sidebarRightTabs` services at load time; every supported DeepSeek Harness release provides

A git install fetches **sources, not built artifacts**, so the package's own `prepare` script builds
the published entry points on your machine: `pnpm run build` emits the declarations with `tsc` and
then bundles both faces with `tsdown`, using only this package's standalone tsconfigs, so no sibling

rst `add` fails with `ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED`. Copy the exact key pnpm prints into the
profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` — for a git-hosted dependency that key is the package name plus the
resolved git spec and commit, and a bare package name does not match it:

## Known Limitations and Deferred Work
- **Independent Git transport** — Remote platform login does not configure Git fetch/push credential

s; existing helpers or SSH remain responsible for Git authentication.
- **Bounded command output** —
a diff larger than `maxOutputBytes` retains only the subprocess collector's tail, so deployments ha

ndling very large diffs must raise that validated setting.
- **Generation needs host + model** — com
mit message generation requires a host LLM runtime and a resolvable model (session default or a cust
om route in Plugin configuration); without either, the Generate action stays disabled or reports `gi

t/generation-unavailable`.
- **Worktree entry needs a live directory service** — without the host wo
rking-directory service, or without a live agent for that session, the checkout list stays read-only
. Writes then keep the previous caller-supplied repository contract. A missing directory is not repa

ired here; recovery belongs to the host working-directory service.
- **Worktree creation needs a rep
orted mode** — the Worktrees tab appears only while the host reports `upstream` (the experimental `w
orktrees` service is mounted) or `local` (the `git-worktrees` `enabled` setting is on); otherwise `c
reate-worktree` refuses. Local-mode creation still works without a session — the checkout is created
efuses. Local-mode creation still works without a session — the checkout is created but not entered.
